## Results

**Polish Wikipedia (Astronomia):** No clear trend. Interest shows -9.6% growth (90% range -23.8% to +8.8%), averaging 1,198 views/month. The 90% range includes zero, so there's no statistically clear change. The topic has a strong seasonal peak in September (+47.8% vs average).

**Czech Wikipedia (Astronomie):** Declining. Interest fell 22.9% (90% range -31.6% to -11.2%) with high confidence, averaging 538 views/month. The decline is consistent—10 of 12 months were below their year-ago counterparts. Also seasonal, peaking in September (+22.8% vs average).

**Comparison:** The two editions differ by 13.2 percentage points, but the 90% range (-3.8 to +33.8 points) spans zero, so there's no clear difference between them.

**Caveats:** Both editions show a seasonal pattern (September peaks suggest back-to-school interest). Wikimedia changed bot detection in early 2025, which affects the granularity of these figures. Polish Wikipedia gets roughly twice the monthly traffic on astronomy compared to Czech.

The pageviews signal attention on Wikipedia, not actual demand or interest outside it—validate these trends against other signals before making decisions based on them.
